spanish: y la cigüeña, la garza a su especie, y la abubilla y el murciélago.
grammarChanges: Replaced untranslated Hebrew transcriptions with Spanish common nouns: hasidah -> cigüeña, anafáh -> garza, dukifat -> abubilla, atalef -> murciélago.
Corrected article gender on the feminine singular noun formerly transcribed dukifat: 'el' -> 'la abubilla'.
